# TPC-H SF1 Single Scheduler: master vs remove-next

```bash
QDB_ARGS='--scheduler single --format null' QDB_ALLOCATOR=malloc \
  ../benchmark/tpch/run_tpch.sh ~/Projects/tpch 1
```

`master`: current checkout at benchmark time.  
`remove-next`: separate worktree `/private/tmp/qdb-remove-next`, commit `3d7b364 Remove pull api`.

## Notes

- The regression is broad but not uniform. The biggest relative deltas are Q2,
  Q11, Q22, Q16, Q20, Q8, Q7, Q9, Q18.
- Q1 is flat/slightly faster, which is a useful control: the slowdown is not a
  universal kernel or allocator regression.
- Q9 remove-next run 5 has a visible outlier (`1.159400s`), but Q9 is still
  slower without that outlier.

## remove-next after one-to-one fast paths

`remove-next after`: same branch with scheduler lowerer fast paths for single-lane
one-to-one connections. The working tree had the fast-path change applied but not
committed at benchmark time.
